objective: Find strategies or a small complementary strategy set that can be executed reliably with RMB 0.2m-2m, have a plausible durable return source, and can be promoted from research to frozen paper trading and eventually small-capital live trading. RMB 10m is retained as a scalability diagnostic rather than a universal exclusion gate.
non_negotiable_validity_gates: No unrepaired future-data use in the promoted implementation.
All core market, membership, lifecycle, status and financial inputs are point-in-time for the observation date.
Execution semantics match the asset class: A-share lot size, T+1, suspension, price limits, partial fills, failed sells, available cash, commissions and taxes are handled where applicable.
Baseline costs are non-zero and realistic for the strategy; a more conservative cost scenario is also reported.
A strategy whose edge depends on intraday queueing, auction or limit-up fills cannot advance to R3 using daily bars alone.
The production-time data required by an R3/R4 strategy must have an identified source, timestamp contract and failure policy.
Failed experiments and rejected variants are retained rather than removed from the evidence set.
diagnostics_not_universal_R4_exclusions: PBO above a single fixed threshold
Deflated Sharpe below a single fixed threshold
Worst rolling three-year return below zero

oos_integrity.A: Exact source/parameter vintage can be shown to predate the OOS interval.
oos_integrity.B: Publication date is known but later source edits cannot be fully excluded; use with downgraded confidence.
oos_integrity.C: Only a current source snapshot exists; the post-publication interval is not treated as strict natural OOS.

correctness_repair.purpose: Remove lookahead, data-contract, accounting, lifecycle or execution errors without optimizing returns.
correctness_repair.rule: May inspect full history to locate implementation defects, but must report before/after performance and may not choose the fix by return maximization.

risk_execution_engineering.purpose: Improve diversification, liquidity, turnover, sizing or risk control.
risk_execution_engineering.rule: Hypothesis, development window and success criteria are frozen before results.

alpha_change.purpose: Change factors, state logic, universe construction or signal composition.
alpha_change.rule: Creates a new candidate version. Previously viewed OOS becomes in-sample and cannot be reused as independent validation.

planning_stress.purpose: Capital-planning sanity stress only; not a statistical forecast or universal pass/fail test.

R1: All non-negotiable validity gates relevant to the strategy are satisfied or explicitly scoped out.
R2: Causal implementation retains a plausible economically explainable edge or portfolio diversification value after realistic costs.
Performance is not supported only by a single parameter point, year, security or impossible fill path.
Simple baselines and factor exposures have been reported.
R3: Source and parameters are frozen with hashes.
RMB 0.2m-2m execution is structurally feasible under modeled costs and liquidity.
Local and JoinQuant/platform behavior is directionally reconciled where feasible.
Known implementation and production-data risks are documented with monitoring rules.
R4: There is evidence not used to tune the frozen version: natural post-publication OOS of credible vintage or forward paper-trading evidence with sufficient independent signal events.
Observed execution divergence does not invalidate the expected edge.
Capital-planning stress is acceptable for the intended personal allocation.
R5: R4 evidence remains valid and RMB 10m capacity diagnostics show a usable exposure/cost profile or a documented scalable execution plan.
Concentration and multiple-testing diagnostics are strong enough for the larger capital at risk.

joinquant_archive: multi-asset ETF momentum + EPO, public backtest end 2024-03-21, post 2024-03-23
joinquant_archive: white-horse offense/defense, public backtest end 2024-10-03, post 2024-10-05

evaluate: marginal Sharpe and drawdown improvement versus a simple core portfolio
portfolio_level_final_selection.rule: Do not select the final set only by standalone CAGR.

stop_rules: Causal repair removes most of the edge and no independent economic thesis remains.
Credible natural OOS materially reverses the original thesis with adequate observations.
Returns depend predominantly on fills that cannot be executed in reality.
Only a narrow parameter spike works and small perturbations collapse performance.
A complex version fails to add meaningful value versus a simple baseline.
Repeated exception rules are added to repair one failed historical interval.
Required production data cannot be obtained reliably before the trading decision.
decision_rule: Hard validity and execution defects can block promotion. Statistical diagnostics and RMB 10m scalability inform confidence and sizing, but do not automatically reject a strategy that is reliable and valuable at the primary RMB 0.2m-2m scale.
